one_line: A relatable scene, hands-only top-down packing with a new product every 2 seconds, and a comment word for the list.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 hands tilt a bright green dinosaur-face suitcase on a bed, then open it. Headline over it: "אמא ומטפלת באמנות מתכוננת לטיסה". Said (transcript): "אמא ומטפלת באומנות מתכוננת לטיסה ארוכה?", then "פרק שני".
q1_hook.why: A bright suitcase handled in frame one, a headline with a role and a scene, and a voice from 0:00 (H1, S1, T3, H4, H6). But the opening is a label, not a problem or result, and what the Reel gives a parent is clear only after about 7 s (H2).

beats.what: Hands tilt and open a green dinosaur suitcase; headline "אמא ומטפלת באמנות מתכוננת לטיסה"
beats.why: A role and a scene in a bright image.

beats.what: Suitcase upright, then open with books; "טיסה לחופשה", "היא אחד המעברים"
beats.why: Frames the flight as a big change for children.

beats.what: Top-down hands pack Giotto marker boxes, a crayon tub and pens into cases
beats.why: The first products appear while the voice says "the only constant is us".

beats.what: Watercolour set, brushes, a pink pouch, then sticker sheets
beats.why: A new item every 2 to 3 s.

beats.what: Stickers in a zip bag; Pongo clay, a clay tub, an organiser box of coloured clay
beats.why: Sensory materials, said to help emotional regulation.

beats.what: Workbook, clipboard, drawing pads and a whiteboard slide in; "ארזתי גם בלב"
beats.why: The rest of the kit, then the emotional line.

beats.what: The full suitcase; "💌 בואו לתיאור"; "יזכרו מהמסע... להרגיש"
beats.why: Ties the kit to how the children will feel.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption: "הגיבו כאן ״אמנות״ ואשלח" for the list of materials, and a joke question about waiting for the 11-hour flight. On screen at 0:55: "💌 בואו לתיאור". The voice promises games in the next episode.
q2_flow.why: A new item every 2 s, each shown while the voice says why, keeps the packing moving (R3, F8), with the advice inside a feeling (K4). The closing line about how children will feel is the payoff (R4, K1). The first 30 s of voice are abstract over plain boxes (R3), and 57 s is long (R2).

q3_cta.what: On screen at 0:55: "💌 בואו לתיאור", small. Caption: "רוצים לקבל רשימה של חומרי היצירה שבסרטון ופירוט על הנגשת החומר? הגיבו כאן ״אמנות״ ואשלח 💌". Not said in the voice.
q3_cta.why: A comment word that delivers a concrete list, the thing a viewer wonders after seeing the suitcase (C3, C2, R6), with a pointer in the last 2 s (C6). The pointer is small at about 80% down, in the bottom 35% (F2), and the keyword appears only in the caption.

q4_shown.what: Top-down hands only: a green dinosaur suitcase, Giotto packs with readable names (Turbo Giant Pastel, Turbo Maxi Fluo, Cera Maxi, Acquarelli Mini, Pongo) packed beside other brands' items (a clay tub, a workbook, drawing pads, a whiteboard, stickers). No child, face or price.
q4_shown.why: A parent and art therapist packs her own kit, a first-person scenario (S6), with each pack handled one by one from 0:06 (S1, K5). The brand is one of many items on the bed, so no product is the hero (H3), and no child uses anything (K8). Hands only keeps children off screen (S4, S5).

q5_edit.what: 31 shots in 56.8 s, 1.8 s average, straight cuts timed to the voiceover, handheld top-down. Voiceover wall to wall, subtitles a few words at a time. Ends on the finished suitcase from 0:53.
q5_edit.why: A cut for each item keeps the packing moving (E2, R3, F8), and the voice carries the message (E4). The subtitles are faint on the white sheet, so a muted viewer loses part (T1, T5). At 57 s it is long (R2), but it ends on its payoff (E8).

q6_topic.what: Packing a child's suitcase for a long flight with art materials chosen to help them feel safe; episode two. Serves a parent travelling with children.
q6_topic.why: A real parent task before the holidays, in a reassuring frame of change and safety, makes parents feel understood (K6, K7). The practical list sits inside the feeling (K4), and the closing line is the emotional peak (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld top-down phone shots of hands packing on a cream bed sheet in warm sunlight; a dinosaur-face suitcase in the first shots. The creator's hands only, no face, no child. Subtitles about 18% down.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands with readable packs is the first-choice, face-free format (S4, F5, S5, F4), and warm window light looks homemade (H8, F7). The subtitles sit just below the top 14% but are low-contrast on the white sheet (F2, T5).

q8_text.on_screen: A white outlined headline at about 40% down, 0:00 to 0:02: "אמא ומטפלת באמנות מתכוננת לטיסה". Then small white subtitles at about 18% down, a few words at a time: "טיסה לחופשה" (0:03), "הדבר היחיד שנשאר" (0:15), "חומרי יצירה ואומנות" (0:34), "יזכרו מהמסע" (0:53). "💌 בואו לתיאור" at 0:55. Many are faint on the white sheet.
q8_text.caption: "הגיוני שאני כבר מחכה לטיסה של 11 שעות עם הילדים רק בשביל ליצור איתם בכל החומרים האלה? 🤭". About 50 words: a joke question, where to find Giotto, the list offer with the comment word, "בשיתוף @giotto_israel" on the last line. No hashtags.
q8_text.why: The headline states the role and scene in the first 2 s (T3), but the subtitles are faint, often unreadable on the white sheet, and cover only fragments of a long monologue (T5, T1). The caption opens playfully, offers the list, and says "בשיתוף" on its last line (T7, S7, T8).

weak_points: Thirty seconds of abstract voice before the products matter; faint subtitles on the white sheet; many brands on the bed, so no hero product; a small CTA with the keyword only in the caption; 57 s.
lumebook_takeaway: Film a top-down packing scene of a trip or bedtime bag holding the book, one item per 2 s shot, ending on the full bag and a comment word.
not_verified: Which items are Giotto (most packs are named; the clay tub, workbook, pads and whiteboard are other brands); whether she is paid (co-author listed, no label, "בשיתוף" on the last caption line); music; the number of children. Corrections to the first pass: the Giotto packs first appear at 0:06, the suitcase is the opening subject; "בואו לתיאור" is at about 80% down. Plays 6,664, likes 76, comments 35 on 15 Oct are context only. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
